split_policy: Independent task-specific official Train/Dev/Test; no cross-task or cross-release training.
representation: Shared frozen HumanOmniV2 C/A/Q/V features and Train-only unsupervised projections. Import only event_projections from audited development checkpoints, no trained downstream weights.
pooling: Mean and population standard deviation over all 172-dimensional event vectors; 344 pooled features, standardized using Train only.
architecture: Linear(344,H), GELU, Dropout(0.1), Linear(H,H/2), GELU, Linear(H/2,1). No severity head.
loss: BCEWithLogits with Train negative-to-positive count ratio as positive weight; binary screening targets only. No continuous score targets.
selection: Largest Dev weighted F1, then AUROC, then smallest Dev classification loss; first wins exact ties. All four candidate traces retained.
thresholds: Dev only, 0.10 to 0.90 step 0.005; weighted F1, macro F1, closeness to 0.5.
test_gate: All 15 checkpoints and thresholds locked before Test prediction; all predictions committed before reading Test targets for scoring.
reporting: All five seeds, mean and sample SD; no seed removal or Test-driven retuning. Severity metrics not applicable.
